This led to an incorrect verdict for Atom 6 (Expected: 3, Predicted: 1). While the count is still wrong (actual is 2), the reasoning is factually flawed. More importantly, no expert is assigned to verify the spatial relationship 'to the left' (Atom 5) beyond the geometric auditor which is focused on the truck structure; a specific spatial audit or open-vocabulary bounding box comparison is needed to rigorously prove the elephants are to the left of the *group* of trucks.
